newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar markets shut for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar markets shut for Hindu festival.

text.p: India's sugar markets were closed on Thursday to commemorate a Hindu festival, dealers said.

On Wednesday, sugar prices weakened despite the onset of the festival season, dealers said. "Consumer demand was low inspite of approaching festivals and increased offerings dragged down prices," one dealer said.
Ready delivery S-30 sugar fell by 3-7 rupees to 1,355/1,388 rupees per quintal and M-30 by five to 1,385/1,420 rupees. Sugar mill delivery eased by five to 1,295/1,305 rupees.
